reviews.comment: The best professor to take this class with. He largely works off of Dr. Leyk's slides and quizzes. Class attendance isn't mandatory, but there are so many open-group open-note quizzes that it might as well be. Very easy to get a B if you do the work and go to lab. SHOW UP TO LAB. You get bonus points, and I did most of my learning during the lab.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This year was a bit different as we followed along Dr. Leyk's course. Lectures weren't super helpful as Dr. Pearce basically read off of the slides. A quiz (sometimes two) almost every class period. However, he is pretty lenient and laid back, and clearly very knowledgeable about CS. Fair grading. Great resources and TAs; labs were very helpful.

Dr. Pearce is very knowledgeable and his professional background allows him to bring valuable insight into the real-world application of the content we are learning. If you don't learn well from lectures you may struggle as the course is lecture-heavy, but Dr. Pearce is very open to answering questions.
